global_style: Edgy, urban presentation style featuring brutalist typography, asymmetrical image layouts, high-contrast color blocking, and overlapping graphic elements.

identity_anchors: Oversized, heavy sans-serif typography used as structural frames and background elements.
Asymmetrical overlapping of images, solid color blocks, and text.
Circular typographic badges used as recurring graphical accents.
Vertical and rotated marginalia text for added texture.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
